main_text.head: VNITARVM IVLIAE, CLIVIAE, MONTIVM, Provinciarum.
MEMBRVM QVARTVM
De Provincia Montana, ejusque Comitibus sedecim, Ducibus septem, Sectionibus duabus explicatus.
main_text.p: PROVINCIA MONTANA, ut eam ante omnia primum describamus, partim à Montibus omnibus, quorum in ejus districtu ingens copia, partim à Septem illis Burgis, vulgo Siebenburghe, ex quibus quatuor tantum, sicut etiam eorundem rupibus seu cautibus, castra ceu ἀκροπόλεις Windeccianum, Leoburgicum, quæ Montanæ ditionis sunt, Drachenfelsium Milendonciorum, item & VVolckenburgium, sic dictum, quod altitudine sua nubes pulsent supra Bonam à Friderico Saerwerdano Episcopo Colon. structum, sed hodie destructum; Reliquis tribus Burgis inhabitatis, atque incultis, inædificata sunt, nomenclaturam fortitur. Septem autem Burgi à Sigena usque & traëtu Nassovio deducti ab orientali Rheni parte Coloniensem diocœsin & urbem adspiciunt. De quibus Bernhardus Mollerus in descriptione Rheni:

p.i: Sunt procul à dextro septeni limite Montes, Altius in quorum vertice castra sedent. Pars homini colitur, medium descivit ab usu, Pars hominem nescit, monstra fovere solet. Hic lemurum formæ vulgus terrore fatigant, Hic Acherontæo spectra fragore tonant. Sæpius ascenso frondator vertice, viteis Dum locat insolito, territus hoste fugit. Euro notho septem spectare Colonia monteis, Quin etiam longè castra videre potest. Quatuor exsurgunt, nondum quæ fustulit ætas Castra Diedunbergam monte venustat apô. Salva Draconina restant fastigia rupis, Nubis adhuc restant castra, manere vides.

page.notes: The top of the page shows faint show-through of the reverse page and was not transcribed. Several Greek and Hebrew-like fragments in the verses are doubtful: "apô" in the line "monte venustat apô" is probably a printed ornament or damaged word and may be wrong. The Greek word "ἀκροπόλεις" after "ceu" is copied as read and should be checked. Small roman numerals in the right margin beside the verses (II, III, IIII) are faint and were not transcribed.
